MARS.name: Practice Mars rover mobility and sampling test
MARS.objective: Test autonomous Mars rover mobility on steep rocky terrain and access two geological sampling waypoints, returning with at least 20% modeled battery reserve.

requirements.label: At least 5% of valid candidate area lies in the 12-18 deg slope band
requirements.acceptance_note: Practice-scenario assumption accepted for synthetic testing; not inferred from NASA data.

requirements.label: Candidate slope distribution within 6 deg (Wasserstein-1) of the target at the common comparison support
requirements.acceptance_note: Practice-scenario assumption accepted for synthetic testing; not inferred from NASA data.

requirements.label: At least 100 m unique route distance in the 12-18 deg slope band
requirements.acceptance_note: Practice-scenario assumption accepted for synthetic testing; not inferred from NASA data.

requirements.label: Visit sampling waypoints W1 and W2 on the same route
requirements.acceptance_note: Practice-scenario assumption accepted for synthetic testing; not inferred from NASA data.

requirements.label: Return to start with at least 20% modeled battery reserve
requirements.acceptance_note: Practice-scenario assumption accepted for synthetic testing; not inferred from NASA data.

requirements.label: Exposed mineral context present at sampling area (optional)
requirements.acceptance_note: Practice-scenario assumption accepted for synthetic testing; not inferred from NASA data.

requirements.label: Obstacles below 0.20 m rover clearance (physical field evidence)
requirements.acceptance_note: Practice-scenario assumption accepted for synthetic testing; not inferred from NASA data.

requirements.label: Mars gravity (3.71 m/s2) for mobility behavior
requirements.acceptance_note: Practice-scenario assumption accepted for synthetic testing; not inferred from NASA data.

requirements.label: Mars atmospheric pressure and composition
requirements.acceptance_note: Practice-scenario assumption accepted for synthetic testing; not inferred from NASA data.

assumptions: All terrain in this scenario is synthetic practice data generated from documented formulas; it is not NASA data.
Sampling waypoints W1/W2 are user-designated task locations; mineral identity is not established.
Sampling waypoints W1/W2 are placed inside the candidate zone by the deterministic auto-waypoints-v1 rule (procedural task locations; not evidence-supported sample sites).
forbidden_actions: Use the test-only mock graph resource provider in live mode

MOON.name: Practice lunar surface operations and thermal test
MOON.objective: Test rover surface operations on south-polar lunar terrain, including cold-trap thermal conditions, under lunar gravity and vacuum.

requirements.label: At least 5% of valid candidate area lies in the 12-18 deg slope band
requirements.acceptance_note: Practice-scenario assumption accepted for synthetic testing; not inferred from NASA data.

requirements.label: Candidate slope distribution within 6 deg (Wasserstein-1) of the target at the common comparison support
requirements.acceptance_note: Practice-scenario assumption accepted for synthetic testing; not inferred from NASA data.

requirements.label: Surface temperature minimum at or below 120 K (multi-year minimum)
requirements.acceptance_note: Practice-scenario assumption accepted for synthetic testing; not inferred from NASA data.

requirements.label: Lunar gravity (1.62 m/s2)
requirements.acceptance_note: Practice-scenario assumption accepted for synthetic testing; not inferred from NASA data.

requirements.label: Hard vacuum
requirements.acceptance_note: Practice-scenario assumption accepted for synthetic testing; not inferred from NASA data.

assumptions: All lunar and Earth terrain in this scenario is synthetic practice data; no Diviner or Earth thermal source is configured, so thermal must be UNKNOWN.

ARES-1.name: ARES-1
assumptions: Illustrative engineering values from the AnalogForge brief; not a manufacturer-certified profile.
Energy coefficients are ASSUMED design defaults (architecture 12 section 5), not calibrated.

PRACTICE-LITE.name: PRACTICE-LITE
assumptions: Practice rover: 12 deg safe slope deliberately below the [12,18] deg exposure band; must surface a contract/rover conflict, never a relaxed requirement.

PRACTICE-NO-ENERGY-MODEL.name: PRACTICE-NO-ENERGY-MODEL
assumptions: Practice rover without an energy model: energy-dependent checks must be INCONCLUSIVE (DATA), never zero consumption.

PRACTICE-SMALL-BATTERY.name: PRACTICE-SMALL-BATTERY
assumptions: Practice rover with a 30 Wh battery: a kilometre-scale route must FAIL ENERGY_RESERVE_SHORTFALL (category ROVER) under unchanged requirements.
